## Step 1: Preprocessing, normalization, and differential expression analysis

I struggled to load the needed information from NCBI GEO Analyze with GEO2R script (due to reCAPTCHA errors) for example: 

load counts table from GEO
urld <- "https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/download/?format=file&type=rnaseq_counts"
path <- paste(urld, "acc=GSE190971", "file=GSE190971_raw_counts_GRCh38.p13_NCBI.tsv.gz", sep="&");
tbl <- as.matrix(data.table::fread(path, header=T, colClasses="integer"), rownames="GeneID")

load gene annotations 
apath <- paste(urld, "type=rnaseq_counts", "file=Human.GRCh38.p13.annot.tsv.gz", sep="&")
annot <- data.table::fread(apath, header=T, quote="", stringsAsFactors=F, data.table=F)
rownames(annot) <- annot$GeneID


so I manually downloaded the raw counts and human genome annotation files from the site to being analysis. 


```{r Dataset pulling, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
homedir <- "/Users/jo.lovelace/rbif120"

ptb_raw_counts_table <- read.table(file.path(homedir, "preterm_raw_counts.tsv"), sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
ptb_raw_counts <- file.path(homedir, "preterm_raw_counts.tsv")

preec_raw_counts_table <- read.table(file.path(homedir, "preeclampsia_raw_counts.tsv"), sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
preec_raw_counts <- file.path(homedir, "preeclampsia_raw_counts.tsv")

human_genome <- file.path(homedir,"Human.GRCh38.p13.annot.tsv")

```



```{r Preterm birth dataset, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Version info: R 4.2.2, Biobase 2.58.0, GEOquery 2.66.0, limma 3.54.0
################################################################

library(DESeq2)
library(data.table)
library(pheatmap)

#Load raw counts table
ptb_data <- data.table::fread(ptb_raw_counts)

# Extract gene identifiers
ptb_gene_ids <- ptb_data$GeneID

# Extract count columns
ptb_count_data <- ptb_data[, !"GeneID", with = FALSE]

# Convert to numeric matrix
ptb_tbl <- as.matrix(ptb_count_data)
storage.mode(ptb_tbl) <- "double"

# Assign gene identifiers
rownames(ptb_tbl) <- ptb_gene_ids

############################################################
#### Initial dataset assessment ############################
############################################################

ptb_initial_genes <- nrow(ptb_tbl)
ptb_initial_samples <- ncol(ptb_tbl)

# Missing values
ptb_missing <- sum(is.na(ptb_tbl))

# Duplicate gene identifiers
ptb_duplicates <- sum(duplicated(rownames(ptb_tbl)))

# Negative counts
ptb_negative <- sum(ptb_tbl < 0, na.rm = TRUE)

# Non-integer counts
ptb_noninteger <- sum(
  ptb_tbl %% 1 != 0,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Initial QC summary
ptb_initial_summary <- data.frame(
  Metric = c(
    "Initial genes",
    "Initial samples",
    "Missing values",
    "Duplicate gene IDs",
    "Negative counts",
    "Non-integer counts"
  ),
  Value = c(
    ptb_initial_genes,
    ptb_initial_samples,
    ptb_missing,
    ptb_duplicates,
    ptb_negative,
    ptb_noninteger
  )
)

print(ptb_initial_summary)

# Validate count matrix before integer conversion
stopifnot(all(is.finite(ptb_tbl)))
stopifnot(all(ptb_tbl >= 0))
stopifnot(all(ptb_tbl %% 1 == 0))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(rownames(ptb_tbl)))
stopifnot(!anyNA(rownames(ptb_tbl)))
stopifnot(!any(rownames(ptb_tbl) == ""))

# Convert to integer counts
storage.mode(ptb_tbl) <- "integer"

############################################################
#### Library Sizes #########################################
############################################################
# Calculate total reads per sample
library_sizes <- colSums(ptb_tbl)

# Check for missing values
sum(is.na(ptb_tbl))

# Check library sizes
summary(library_sizes)

# Visualize library sizes
barplot(library_sizes,
        main = "Preterm Birth: Library Sizes",
        ylab = "Total Counts",
        las = 2,
        col = "steelblue")

############################################################
#### Load gene annotations #################################
############################################################
ptb_annot <- data.table::fread(human_genome, header = TRUE, quote = "", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, data.table = FALSE)

rownames(ptb_annot) <- ptb_annot$GeneID

sum(duplicated(rownames(ptb_annot)))
sum(rownames(ptb_tbl) %in% rownames(ptb_annot))

# Sample selection
ptb_gsms <- "00000000000000000000000111111111111111"
ptb_sml <- strsplit(ptb_gsms, split = "")[[1]]

# Group membership for samples
ptb_gs <- factor(ptb_sml)
# Verify number of group assignments matches sample count
stopifnot(length(ptb_gs) == ncol(ptb_tbl))
table(ptb_gs) # Check group sizes

ptb_groups <- make.names(c("Ctrl", "Tx"))
levels(ptb_gs) <- ptb_groups
ptb_sample_info <- data.frame(Group = ptb_gs, row.names = colnames(ptb_tbl))

ptb_sample_check <- data.frame(
  Sample = colnames(ptb_tbl),
  Group = ptb_gs
)

print(ptb_sample_check)

############################################################
#### Pre-filter low count genes ############################
############################################################
# Keep genes with at least N counts ,
# where N = size of smallest group
# Record initial number of genes
ptb_genes_before <- nrow(ptb_tbl)
ptb_samples_before <- ncol(ptb_tbl)

# Apply low-count filtering
ptb_keep <- rowSums(ptb_tbl >= 10) >= min(table(ptb_gs))

ptb_tbl <- ptb_tbl[ptb_keep, ]

# Record genes after filtering
ptb_genes_after <- nrow(ptb_tbl)

# Calculate genes removed
ptb_genes_removed <- ptb_genes_before - ptb_genes_after

# Calculate percentage removed
ptb_percent_removed <- (
  ptb_genes_removed / ptb_genes_before
) * 100

# Create before/after summary
ptb_sample_summary <- data.frame(
  Stage = c("Before filtering", "After filtering"),
  Genes = c(ptb_genes_before, ptb_genes_after),
  Samples = c(ptb_samples_before, ncol(ptb_tbl))
)

print(ptb_sample_summary)

cat("Genes removed:", ptb_genes_removed, "\n")
cat("Percentage removed:", round(ptb_percent_removed, 2), "%")

barplot(
  ptb_sample_summary$Genes,
  names.arg = ptb_sample_summary$Stage,
  main = "Preterm Birth: Genes Before and After Filtering",
  ylab = "Number of Genes",
  col = c("lightblue", "steelblue")
)

############################################################
#### Create DESeq2 dataset #################################
############################################################
ptb_ds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = ptb_tbl, colData = ptb_sample_info, design = ~Group)
ptb_ds <- DESeq(ptb_ds, test = "Wald", sfType = "poscounts")

# Variance stabilizing transformation
ptb_vsd <- vst(ptb_ds, blind = TRUE)

# Examine DESeq2 normalization factors
sizeFactors(ptb_ds)

# Calculate normalized library sizes
normalized_library_sizes <- colSums(
  counts(ptb_ds, normalized = TRUE)
)

summary(normalized_library_sizes)

############################################################
#### PCA plot ##############################################
############################################################
plotPCA(ptb_vsd, intgroup = "Group")

# Extract transformed expression data
ptb_mat <- assay(ptb_vsd)

# Calculate sample correlations
ptb_cor <- cor(ptb_mat)

# Generate heatmap
pheatmap(ptb_cor,
         main = "Preterm Birth Sample-to-Sample Correlation",
         clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
         clustering_distance_cols = "correlation")

############################################################
#### Extract results for top genes table ###################
############################################################
ptb_r <- results(ptb_ds,
             contrast = c("Group", "Tx", "Ctrl"),
             alpha = 0.05,
             pAdjustMethod = "fdr")

ptb_r <- ptb_r[!is.na(ptb_r$padj), ]

############################################################
#### Identify significantly upregulated genes ##############
############################################################
ptb_r_up <- ptb_r[ptb_r$padj < 0.05 & ptb_r$log2FoldChange > 1, ]
ptb_tT_up <- ptb_r_up[order(ptb_r_up$padj), ]

# Merge upregulated genes with annotations
ptb_tT_up <- merge(as.data.frame(ptb_tT_up), ptb_annot, by = 0, sort = FALSE)

# Rename merged gene column
colnames(ptb_tT_up)[1] <- "GeneID"

# Select desired columns
ptb_tT_up <- subset(ptb_tT_up, select = c("GeneID", "padj", "pvalue",
                            "lfcSE", "stat", "log2FoldChange",
                            "baseMean", "Symbol", "Description"))

# Extract upregulated gene symbols
ptb_symbols_up <- unique(na.omit(ptb_tT_up$Symbol))
print(length(ptb_symbols_up))

# Export upregulated gene symbols
writeLines(ptb_symbols_up, file.path(homedir, "ptb_up_gene_symbols.txt"))

############################################################
### Identify significantly downregulated genes #############
############################################################
ptb_r_down <- ptb_r[ptb_r$padj < 0.05 & ptb_r$log2FoldChange < -1, ]
ptb_tT_down <- ptb_r_down[order(ptb_r_down$padj), ]

# Merge downregulated genes with annotations
ptb_tT_down <- merge(as.data.frame(ptb_tT_down), ptb_annot, by = 0, sort = FALSE)

# Rename merged gene column
colnames(ptb_tT_down)[1] <- "GeneID"

# Select desired columns
ptb_tT_down <- subset(ptb_tT_down, select = c("GeneID", "padj", "pvalue",
                            "lfcSE", "stat", "log2FoldChange",
                            "baseMean", "Symbol", "Description"))

# Extract downregulated gene symbols
ptb_symbols_down <- unique(na.omit(ptb_tT_down$Symbol))
print(length(ptb_symbols_down))

# Export downregulated gene symbols
writeLines(ptb_symbols_down, file.path(homedir, "ptb_down_gene_symbols.txt"))
```




```{r Preeclampsia dataset, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Version info: R 4.2.2, Biobase 2.58.0, GEOquery 2.66.0, limma 3.54.0
################################################################

library(DESeq2)
library(data.table)
library(pheatmap)

#Load raw counts table
preec_data <- data.table::fread(preec_raw_counts)

# Extract gene identifiers
preec_gene_ids <- preec_data$GeneID

# Extract count columns
preec_count_data <- preec_data[, !"GeneID", with = FALSE]

# Convert to numeric matrix
preec_tbl <- as.matrix(preec_count_data)
storage.mode(preec_tbl) <- "double"

# Assign gene identifiers
rownames(preec_tbl) <- preec_gene_ids

############################################################
#### Initial dataset assessment ############################
############################################################

preec_initial_genes <- nrow(preec_tbl)
preec_initial_samples <- ncol(preec_tbl)

# Missing values
preec_missing <- sum(is.na(preec_tbl))

# Duplicate gene identifiers
preec_duplicates <- sum(duplicated(rownames(preec_tbl)))

# Negative counts
preec_negative <- sum(preec_tbl < 0, na.rm = TRUE)

# Non-integer counts
preec_noninteger <- sum(
  preec_tbl %% 1 != 0,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Initial QC summary
preec_initial_summary <- data.frame(
  Metric = c(
    "Initial genes",
    "Initial samples",
    "Missing values",
    "Duplicate gene IDs",
    "Negative counts",
    "Non-integer counts"
  ),
  Value = c(
    preec_initial_genes,
    preec_initial_samples,
    preec_missing,
    preec_duplicates,
    preec_negative,
    preec_noninteger
  )
)

print(preec_initial_summary)

# Validate count matrix before integer conversion
stopifnot(all(is.finite(preec_tbl)))
stopifnot(all(preec_tbl >= 0))
stopifnot(all(preec_tbl %% 1 == 0))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(rownames(preec_tbl)))
stopifnot(!anyNA(rownames(preec_tbl)))
stopifnot(!any(rownames(preec_tbl) == ""))

# Convert to integer counts
storage.mode(preec_tbl) <- "integer"

############################################################
#### Library Sizes #########################################
############################################################
# Calculate total reads per sample
preec_library_sizes <- colSums(preec_tbl)

# Check for missing values
sum(is.na(preec_tbl))

# Check library sizes
summary(preec_library_sizes)

# Visualize library sizes
barplot(preec_library_sizes,
        main = "Preeclampsia: Library Sizes",
        ylab = "Total Counts",
        las = 2,
        col = "steelblue")

############################################################
#### Load gene annotations #################################
############################################################
preec_annot <- data.table::fread(human_genome, header = TRUE, quote = "", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, data.table = FALSE)

rownames(preec_annot) <- preec_annot$GeneID

sum(duplicated(rownames(preec_annot)))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(preec_annot$GeneID))
stopifnot(!anyNA(preec_annot$GeneID))

sum(rownames(preec_tbl) %in% rownames(preec_annot))

# Sample selection
preec_gsms <- "00000011111112222224444444433333355555555"
preec_sml <- strsplit(preec_gsms, split = "")[[1]]

# Group membership for samples
preec_gs <- factor(preec_sml)
# Verify number of group assignments matches sample count
stopifnot(length(preec_gs) == ncol(preec_tbl))
table(preec_gs) # Check group sizes

preec_groups <- make.names(c("Placenta_Ctrl", "Placenta_Tx", "MedLarge_Ctrl", "MedLarge_Tx", "Small_Ctrl", "Small_Tx"))
levels(preec_gs) <- preec_groups
preec_sample_info <- data.frame(Group = preec_gs, row.names = colnames(preec_tbl))

preec_sample_check <- data.frame(
  Sample = colnames(preec_tbl),
  Group = preec_gs
)

print(preec_sample_check)

############################################################
#### Pre-filter low count genes ############################
############################################################
# Keep genes with at least N counts ,
# where N = size of smallest group
# Record initial number of genes
preec_genes_before <- nrow(preec_tbl)
preec_samples_before <- ncol(preec_tbl)

# Apply low-count filtering
preec_keep <- rowSums(preec_tbl >= 10) >= min(table(preec_gs))

preec_tbl <- preec_tbl[preec_keep, ]

# Record genes after filtering
preec_genes_after <- nrow(preec_tbl)

# Calculate genes removed
preec_genes_removed <- preec_genes_before - preec_genes_after

# Calculate percentage removed
preec_percent_removed <- (
  preec_genes_removed / preec_genes_before
) * 100

# Create before/after summary
preec_sample_summary <- data.frame(
  Stage = c("Before filtering", "After filtering"),
  Genes = c(preec_genes_before, preec_genes_after),
  Samples = c(preec_samples_before, ncol(preec_tbl))
)

print(preec_sample_summary)

cat("Genes removed:", preec_genes_removed, "\n")
cat("Percentage removed:", round(preec_percent_removed, 2), "%")

barplot(
  preec_sample_summary$Genes,
  names.arg = preec_sample_summary$Stage,
  main = "Preeclampsia: Genes Before and After Filtering",
  ylab = "Number of Genes",
  col = c("lightblue", "steelblue")
)

############################################################
#### Create DESeq2 dataset #################################
############################################################
preec_ds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = preec_tbl, colData = preec_sample_info, design = ~Group)
preec_ds <- DESeq(preec_ds, test = "Wald", sfType = "poscounts")

# Variance stabilizing transformation
preec_vsd <- vst(preec_ds, blind = TRUE)

# Examine DESeq2 normalization factors
sizeFactors(preec_ds)

# Calculate normalized library sizes
preec_normalized_library_sizes <- colSums(
  counts(preec_ds, normalized = TRUE)
)

summary(preec_normalized_library_sizes)

############################################################
#### PCA plot ##############################################
############################################################
plotPCA(preec_vsd, intgroup = "Group")

# Extract transformed expression data
preec_mat <- assay(preec_vsd)

# Calculate sample correlations
preec_cor <- cor(preec_mat)

# Generate heatmap
pheatmap(preec_cor,
         main = "Preeclampsia Sample-to-Sample Correlation",
         clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
         clustering_distance_cols = "correlation")

############################################################
#### Placenta: Differential Expression Analysis ############
############################################################

preec_r_placenta <- results(preec_ds,contrast = c("Group", "Placenta_Tx", "Placenta_Ctrl"), alpha = 0.05)

preec_r_medlarge <- results(preec_ds,contrast = c("Group", "MedLarge_Tx", "MedLarge_Ctrl"), alpha = 0.05)

preec_r_small <- results(preec_ds,contrast = c("Group", "Small_Tx", "Small_Ctrl"), alpha = 0.05)

# Remove genes without adjusted p-values
preec_r_placenta <- preec_r_placenta[ !is.na(preec_r_placenta$padj),]
preec_r_medlarge <- preec_r_medlarge[ !is.na(preec_r_medlarge$padj),]
preec_r_small <- preec_r_small[ !is.na(preec_r_small$padj),]

############################################################
#### Identify significantly upregulated genes ##############
############################################################

######## Placenta Group ####################################
preec_up_placenta <- preec_r_placenta[ preec_r_placenta$padj < 0.05 & preec_r_placenta$log2FoldChange > 1,]

preec_up_placenta <- as.data.frame(preec_up_placenta)

# Add gene identifiers
preec_up_placenta$GeneID <- rownames(preec_up_placenta)

# Merge with gene annotations
preec_up_placenta <- merge(preec_up_placenta,preec_annot,by = "GeneID",sort = FALSE)

# Order by adjusted p-value
preec_up_placenta <- preec_up_placenta[order(preec_up_placenta$padj),]

# Select desired columns
preec_up_placenta <- subset(preec_up_placenta,select = c(
    "GeneID", "padj", "pvalue", "lfcSE",
    "stat", "log2FoldChange", "baseMean",
    "Symbol", "Description"
  ))

# Extract gene symbols
preec_symbols_up_placenta <- unique(na.omit(preec_up_placenta$Symbol))
print(length(preec_symbols_up_placenta))

# Export gene symbols
writeLines(preec_symbols_up_placenta,file.path(homedir, "preec_up_placenta_gene_symbols.txt"))

######## MedLarge Group ####################################
preec_up_medlarge <- preec_r_medlarge[ preec_r_medlarge$padj < 0.05 & preec_r_medlarge$log2FoldChange > 1,]

preec_up_medlarge <- as.data.frame(preec_up_medlarge)

# Add gene identifiers
preec_up_medlarge$GeneID <- rownames(preec_up_medlarge)

# Merge with gene annotations
preec_up_medlarge <- merge(preec_up_medlarge,preec_annot,by = "GeneID",sort = FALSE)

# Order by adjusted p-value
preec_up_medlarge <- preec_up_medlarge[order(preec_up_medlarge$padj),]

# Select desired columns
preec_up_medlarge <- subset(preec_up_medlarge,select = c(
    "GeneID", "padj", "pvalue", "lfcSE",
    "stat", "log2FoldChange", "baseMean",
    "Symbol", "Description"
  ))

# Extract gene symbols
preec_symbols_up_medlarge <- unique(na.omit(preec_up_medlarge$Symbol))
print(length(preec_symbols_up_medlarge))

# Export gene symbols
writeLines(preec_symbols_up_medlarge,file.path(homedir, "preec_up_medlarge_gene_symbols.txt"))


######## Small Group ####################################
preec_up_small <- preec_r_small[ preec_r_small$padj < 0.05 & preec_r_small$log2FoldChange > 1,]

preec_up_small <- as.data.frame(preec_up_small)

# Add gene identifiers
preec_up_small$GeneID <- rownames(preec_up_small)

# Merge with gene annotations
preec_up_small <- merge(preec_up_small,preec_annot,by = "GeneID",sort = FALSE)

# Order by adjusted p-value
preec_up_small <- preec_up_small[order(preec_up_small$padj),]

# Select desired columns
preec_up_small <- subset(preec_up_small,select = c(
    "GeneID", "padj", "pvalue", "lfcSE",
    "stat", "log2FoldChange", "baseMean",
    "Symbol", "Description"
  ))

# Extract gene symbols
preec_symbols_up_small <- unique(na.omit(preec_up_small$Symbol))
print(length(preec_symbols_up_small))

# Export gene symbols
writeLines(preec_symbols_up_small,file.path(homedir, "preec_up_small_gene_symbols.txt"))

############################################################
#### Identify significantly downregulated genes ############
############################################################

######## Placenta Group ####################################
preec_down_placenta <- preec_r_placenta[preec_r_placenta$padj < 0.05 & preec_r_placenta$log2FoldChange < -1,]

preec_down_placenta <- as.data.frame(preec_down_placenta)

# Add gene identifiers
preec_down_placenta$GeneID <- rownames(preec_down_placenta)

# Merge with gene annotations
preec_down_placenta <- merge(preec_down_placenta,preec_annot,by = "GeneID",sort = FALSE)

# Order by adjusted p-value
preec_down_placenta <- preec_down_placenta[order(preec_down_placenta$padj),]

# Select desired columns
preec_down_placenta <- subset(preec_down_placenta,select = c(
    "GeneID", "padj", "pvalue", "lfcSE",
    "stat", "log2FoldChange", "baseMean",
    "Symbol", "Description"
  ))

# Extract gene symbols
preec_symbols_down_placenta <- unique(na.omit(preec_down_placenta$Symbol))
print(length(preec_symbols_down_placenta))

# Export gene symbols
writeLines(preec_symbols_down_placenta,file.path(homedir, "preec_down_placenta_gene_symbols.txt"))

######## MedLarge Group ####################################
preec_down_medlarge <- preec_r_medlarge[preec_r_medlarge$padj < 0.05 & preec_r_medlarge$log2FoldChange < -1,]

preec_down_medlarge <- as.data.frame(preec_down_medlarge)

# Add gene identifiers
preec_down_medlarge$GeneID <- rownames(preec_down_medlarge)

# Merge with gene annotations
preec_down_medlarge <- merge(preec_down_medlarge,preec_annot,by = "GeneID",sort = FALSE)

# Order by adjusted p-value
preec_down_medlarge <- preec_down_medlarge[order(preec_down_medlarge$padj),]

# Select desired columns
preec_down_medlarge <- subset(preec_down_medlarge,select = c(
    "GeneID", "padj", "pvalue", "lfcSE",
    "stat", "log2FoldChange", "baseMean",
    "Symbol", "Description"
  ))

# Extract gene symbols
preec_symbols_down_medlarge <- unique(na.omit(preec_down_medlarge$Symbol))
print(length(preec_symbols_down_medlarge))

# Export gene symbols
writeLines(preec_symbols_down_medlarge,file.path(homedir, "preec_down_medlarge_gene_symbols.txt"))

######## Small Group ####################################
preec_down_small <- preec_r_small[preec_r_small$padj < 0.05 & preec_r_small$log2FoldChange < -1,]

preec_down_small <- as.data.frame(preec_down_small)

# Add gene identifiers
preec_down_small$GeneID <- rownames(preec_down_small)

# Merge with gene annotations
preec_down_small <- merge(preec_down_small,preec_annot,by = "GeneID",sort = FALSE)

# Order by adjusted p-value
preec_down_small <- preec_down_small[order(preec_down_small$padj),]

# Select desired columns
preec_down_small <- subset(preec_down_small,select = c(
    "GeneID", "padj", "pvalue", "lfcSE",
    "stat", "log2FoldChange", "baseMean",
    "Symbol", "Description"
  ))

# Extract gene symbols
preec_symbols_down_small <- unique(na.omit(preec_down_small$Symbol))
cat("preec_symbols_down_small", length(preec_symbols_down_small), "\n")

# Export gene symbols
writeLines(preec_symbols_down_small,file.path(homedir, "preec_down_small_gene_symbols.txt"))
```

## Step 2: Finding overlapping genes between the preterm birth and preeclampsia datasets

